name: Percy Andrade
life: “We worked the night the cove froze at its very edge.” People around the corner by Juniper Tailor know Percy by a small Friday habit. Percy looks at the things people actually bring in for repair before looking in the display window.
voice: I scraped my knee there and have called it a much ruder name since. The choir wants to use it.
appearance: Percy has a long face and high cheekbones. Look for salt-and-pepper curls. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a narrow-striped sweater with a narrow brass watch set a little fast. In conversation Percy rubs a thumb along the edge of the nearest pocket.
personality: Percy gets protective of anybody who comes into a meeting unprepared. Percy privately wishes people would notice the amount of preparation behind this apparent ease.
agenda: To teach the choir the name adults only use in bad weather.
family: Lola Jeong is Percy’s younger cousin. Percy asks before bringing somebody along. Lola can always ask for five minutes alone. It keeps a conversation between two people from unexpectedly turning into a family committee. Asked about *The button card*, Lola says, “I came to return a button my wife thought unlucky.”
connections: Ruben Keller. They decide which decidedly unofficial name can appear on the choir sheet.

reactions.situation: A child asks to listen with bare feet
reactions.response: Percy checks where the wet stone is stable and lets the child listen from there.

reactions.situation: An argument on the pavement makes a bystander feel unsafe
reactions.response: Percy walks with the bystander to a staffed doorway and checks whether they want someone called.

reactions.situation: If a colleague lies to save face
reactions.response: Percy offers one private chance to correct it before the next conversation.
